# Voxelize

> Multiplayer voxel engine: an authoritative Rust server (`voxelize` crate) and TypeScript client packages (`@voxelize/core` and friends) on three.js. Chunked worlds with a WASM mesher, voxel lighting, an ECS with server-streamed entities, and GPU-instanced animated entities.

Notes for agents:
- Docs and skills matching the installed version ship inside the package: read `node_modules/@voxelize/core/skills/<topic>/SKILL.md` for the task first, then the typed API in `node_modules/@voxelize/core/dist/**/*.d.ts`. Run `npx voxelize-agents init` once in a project to point AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md at them.
- The server is authoritative; clients render and request.
- Anything that can number in the dozens (animals, mobs, crowds) is instanced with `defineSkinnedFamily`, not a mesh per entity.
- The `examples/` folder of the repository is the compiling reference for every skill.

## Skills

- [Instanced entities](https://github.com/voxelize/voxelize/blob/main/packages/core/skills/voxelize-instanced-entities/SKILL.md): creatures and many-of-a-kind animated entities with `defineSkinnedFamily`, server spawning, warmup, lighting and shadows.
- [Entity motion](https://github.com/voxelize/voxelize/blob/main/packages/core/skills/voxelize-entity-motion/SKILL.md): stride-paced walks, server following, head look, strikes, hit flash, death, and IK feet on voxel terrain.

## Tutorials

- [What is Voxelize](https://docs.voxelize.io/tutorials/intro/what-is-voxelize): the architecture.
- [Getting started](https://docs.voxelize.io/tutorials/intro/getting-started): server, world, registry, client in order.
- [The client entity](https://docs.voxelize.io/tutorials/intermediate/the-client-entity): `Entities`, `Entity`, `setClass`.
- [Custom entity creation](https://docs.voxelize.io/tutorials/intermediate/custom-entity-creation): server entity loaders and components.
- [Metadata component](https://docs.voxelize.io/tutorials/intermediate/metadata-component): what the server streams per entity.
- [Method handling](https://docs.voxelize.io/tutorials/intermediate/method-handling): client-to-server calls.
- [Custom blocks](https://docs.voxelize.io/tutorials/intermediate/custom-blocks): block registry and dynamic shapes.
